prompt:

Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — uncanny (a.神秘的，不可思议的): An adult sees an eerily exact duplicate of their handmade doll in a dim shop window, startled quiet expression.
TOP RIGHT — erase (v.擦，抹去): A hand uses a rubber eraser to remove pencil marks from a page, one clean section and a few eraser crumbs visible.
BOTTOM LEFT — praying mantis (螳螂): A scientifically recognizable green praying mantis stands on a twig with triangular head and folded grasping forelegs, long body, no exaggerated monster form.
BOTTOM RIGHT — entranced (a.出神的): A person watches a beautiful small butterfly with completely absorbed wide-eyed attention, hands still and soft delighted expression.
review_notes: Viewed all four cells: uncanny duplicate doll, erasing pencil marks, recognizable green mantis with triangular head and folded raptorial forelegs, and entranced butterfly observer. No readable text, boundary crossing, or obvious anatomy defects.
